note: Address display provides one field formatter, address_display_formatter (label 'Address Display'), for fields of type address (requires the address module). It has no settings form, no configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, and no plugin type. Configuration is per field, per view mode, stored on core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field> with type: address_display_formatter and settings.address_display.<component>.{display,glue,weight}. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real view-display config on a node.article address field (field_addisp_*). Note the site already has an unrelated field_eval_address; these cases use their own field_addisp_addr / field_addisp_task.

evals.prompt: I want to control which parts of a Drupal address field are shown (e.g. only city and country) and in what order. Which contrib module and which field formatter do I use, and on which field type does it work?
evals.expected_output: Use the Address display module's 'Address Display' formatter (id address_display_formatter). It is a field formatter for fields of type 'address' (from the Address module), selected on the entity's Manage display page.

evals.prompt: In the Address display formatter, how do you choose which address components are shown, their order, and the separator between them? Name the per-component settings.
evals.expected_output: Each address component has three settings under settings.address_display.<component>: display (boolean, show it or not), glue (a separator string appended after the component), and weight (order). Only ticked components render, in weight order, with glue between them (not after the last).

evals.prompt: There is no admin settings page for the Address display module. Where is the 'Address Display' formatter configuration actually stored for a given field, and how would I read it with drush?
evals.expected_output: It is stored on the entity's view display config, core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<view_mode>, under content.<field>.type (address_display_formatter) and content.<field>.settings.address_display. Read it with: drush cget core.entity_view_display.node.article.default content.<field>.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an address field field_addisp_addr whose default display uses the Address display formatter. Inspect the live view-display config and state which two address components are set to display.
evals.expected_output: locality and country_code are set to display:true (postal_code and address_line1 are display:false). In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default, content.field_addisp_addr.type is address_display_formatter with settings.address_display.locality.display=true and .country_code.display=true.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has an address field field_addisp_addr. Inspect the live default view display and state which field formatter (by machine id) is applied to it.
evals.expected_output: The formatter is address_display_formatter: content.field_addisp_addr.type in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default is address_display_formatter.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an address field field_addisp_task that is currently displayed with the core default address formatter. Using the Address display module, change its default view display so the field uses the 'Address Display' formatter (address_display_formatter). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_addisp_task component has type: address_display_formatter (e.g. $vd->setComponent('field_addisp_task', ['type'=>'address_display_formatter', ...])->save(), or pick 'Address Display' on Manage display and Save).

evals.prompt: On my Drupal site, my Article pages have an address field (field_addisp_task) and I want to be able to control exactly which parts of the address show (city, country, etc.). Please switch that field to the Address display module's configurable address formatter on the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_addisp_task component in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default to type address_display_formatter and save.
